snippet.title: Hell Maiden | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Hell Maiden is an action horde survival deck-building game inspired by Dante's Divine Comedy. 

Follow Dante on a new adventure through Hell in search of a second chance at salvation!

⬇️Wishlist now on Steam⬇️
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3372060?utm_source=yttr0525

Hell Maiden's release date is still to be announced — make sure to follow AstralShift on social media and join our Discord server for updates!
